_comment: Default simulation config. Pass with: python run_simulation.py --config config.json
_comment_precedence: Explicit CLI flags always override values set here.
_comment_difficulty_scaling: This file sets resource_density, event_frequency, event_severity, and event_warning_cycles explicitly below. Those four values are pinned: they apply as written regardless of the 'difficulty' field or any '--difficulty' CLI flag, because an explicit --config value always overrides the difficulty-derived default for the same field. '--config config.json --difficulty 60' therefore scales drain, regeneration, and metabolism to difficulty 60, but resource_density/event_frequency/event_severity/event_warning_cycles stay at the values pinned here, not at their difficulty-60 schedule values. Every other field below is either difficulty-independent (grid size, agent count, terrain_variety, max_cycles, ...) or a fixed default (visibility_radius, seed, ...).
